title: Beat the forecaster
tagline: Use the past. Test your guess.
description: Compare a forecast with new evidence. Learn why a small dataset can trick a model.
projectQuestion: What evidence would convince you that your forecast works in a new season?
how: Real mode shows historical sample groups and the observations available before them. The next-record reveal is evidence exploration, not a validated toxic/not-toxic quiz. A blank qualifier is not a confirmed positive result.

Training mode uses 240 invented visits. The first 160 are available for training; the last 80 stay held out. A slider chooses how many early examples the model sees. All inputs precede the pretend result.

Logistic regression adds weighted inputs and turns the sum into a score from 0 to 1. It learns weights only from training rows. Standardization also uses training rows only. A 0.5 cutoff makes a yes/no prediction.
The later simulated period changes one relationship. More data or more inputs may not improve performance. Compare with a model that always picks the most common training outcome.
prompt: Before you try it: what evidence would you want to collect?

challenges.title: Make your own forecast
challenges.goal: Guess the next simulated outcome before revealing it.
challenges.hint: Use the four clues, but leave room for uncertainty.

challenges.title: Build a first model
challenges.goal: Train with at least one input and inspect the held-out results.
challenges.hint: The model must not see the test outcomes while learning.

challenges.title: Test an alternative
challenges.goal: Train two models with different inputs or training histories.
challenges.hint: Compare raw hits, misses and false alarms. More features need not win.

challenges.title: Return to real evidence
challenges.goal: Reveal a real next sample record and identify its limitations.
challenges.hint: Use Real evidence mode. Below-limit results are not safe-lake labels.

omissions: No real-toxin model is trained. The verified record is sparse, seasonal and selectively sampled.
Unmeasured ecology, lab turnaround time and sampling decisions are not fully represented.
Synthetic performance is not evidence that a real forecast works.
realWarning: Measured records, provisional. Mat and water samples have different units. Missing and below-limit results do not establish safety.
simWarning: Simulated training game. These are invented visits and outcomes, not Lady Bird Lake toxin results.
